static_review_findings.finding: Both observers call the original _local_search without changing arguments or returned result. Candidate capture includes all finite prescribed initials, all finite endpoints/fallbacks, explicit incumbent, exact local coordinates, recomputed and recorded objectives, source kind, start index, status and exception.

Solver keys include ordered float64 anchors/RSS/intercepts, receiver count, n, d0. Fixed shapes are implied by receiver count and validated solver contract. No query-reference coordinates, WCL estimate or error enters the hash, solver, candidate ordering or incumbent selection.

recover_candidates.recover_shard returns an existing hash-valid receipt without requiring status COMPLETE; an INVESTIGATION_REQUIRED receipt could be accepted by a later resume. No such receipt exists in this snapshot. Require a final independent check rejecting every non-COMPLETE shard, or version a repair before future resumes after failure; do not alter locked running source.

Original recovery run excludes 64 pilot inputs and its RUN_RECEIPT totals concern the remaining scheduled inputs. Full coverage requires union of pilot and regular candidate shards, exactly one occurrence for every registry input ID.

Calibration aggregate receipt status COMPLETE does not itself guarantee no exceptions; exception count and finite/candidate coverage must be checked explicitly. Current checked shards have no exceptions.
Calibration nlls_input_index is shard-local, including after full-array concatenation. Join via block plus query chunk to candidate shard, and validate input_sha256; never treat index as global.
Recovery stores absolute discrepancies. The plan also requested scale-relative discrepancy reporting; these can be derived additively from EXPECTED_PRIMARY and search scale without replay.

scope: Complete locked original registry and 195,200-state mappings; static capture/selection interface review; calibration completed-shard snapshot only. No new solves, no source edits, no global-optimality or scientific-claim validation.
